format.codec: Each stream runs one encoder() and one decoder() over its batches in order, from base. Per batch: the ops, the exact wire tuples (after a JSON round trip), the decoded ops, and the value after applyImmutable.
format.decodeErrors: Wire batches through one decoder(), in order; the last one throws. Errors are the class name and message.
format.apply: applyImmutable(base, ops) on decoded tuples: the result, or the error's class name and message.
format.diff: diffRevisions(before, after) applied to before. Batches are exact but not canonical, so only the result is recorded.
format.numbers: canonicalJson(JSON.parse(literal)). Parse the literal as a correctly rounded double.
